8_25.en: American Army code breakers had intercepted and deciphered conversations between Japanese leaders in which they announced they had given up on diplomacy with the United States.
8_25.zh: 美國陸軍密碼破譯員攔截並破譯了日本領導人之間的對話，在對話中他們宣布放棄與美國的外交。
chunks: they had given up on diplomacy

reviewData.meaning: 已經攔截並破譯（過去完成式）
reviewData.collocation: intercept a message（攔截訊息）、decipher a code（破解密碼）
reviewData.pronunciation: intercepted 重音在第三音節 /ˌɪn.tərˈsep.tɪd/，deciphered 重音在第二音節 /dɪˈsaɪ.fərd/。

reviewData.meaning: 放棄了外交途徑（give up on = 放棄）
reviewData.collocation: give up on negotiations（放棄談判）
reviewData.pronunciation: given up on 連讀，on 弱讀為 /ɒn/，diplomacy 重音在第二音節 /dɪˈploʊ.mə.si/。

8_25.en: To avoid having his critical message fall into Japanese hands, Marshall decided against using the Scrambler and instead sent his orders to Hawaii via telegraph code.
8_25.zh: 為了避免他的關鍵信息落入日本人手中，馬歇爾決定不使用擾頻器，而是透過電報密碼將命令發送到夏威夷。
chunks: To avoid having his critical message

reviewData.meaning: 落入日本人手中（fall into someone's hands = 落入某人控制）
reviewData.collocation: fall into enemy hands（落入敵手）
reviewData.synonym: be captured by / be obtained by the Japanese
reviewData.pronunciation: fall into 連讀，into 弱讀為 /ɪntə/，Japanese 重音在第三音節 /ˌdʒæp.əˈniːz/。

reviewData.meaning: 決定不使用（decide against = 決定反對/不做）
reviewData.collocation: decide against taking the risk（決定不冒險）
reviewData.synonym: chose not to use / rejected the idea of using
reviewData.pronunciation: decided 字尾 /d/ 和 against 的 /ə/ 連讀，against 重音在第二音節 /əˈɡenst/。

8_25.en: The disaster at Pearl Harbor confirmed what Marshall and other military leaders already knew: they needed a secure system for communication with their troops.
8_25.zh: 珍珠港的災難證實了馬歇爾和其他軍事領導人已經知道的事情：他們需要一個安全的系統來與部隊通訊。

reviewData.meaning: 證實了...早已知道的事情
reviewData.collocation: confirm one's suspicions（證實某人的懷疑）
reviewData.synonym: validated / proved what was already suspected
reviewData.pronunciation: confirmed 重音在第二音節 /kənˈfɜːrmd/，already 重音在第二音節 /ɔːlˈredi/。
secure 重音在第二音節 /sɪˈkjʊər/，communication 重音在第三音節 /kəˌmjuː.nɪˈkeɪ.ʃn/。

8_25.en: Advances in computing power allowed for more values to be added to the equation, so that conversations could be replayed continuously and without gaps.
8_25.zh: 計算能力的進步允許將更多數值添加到方程式中，以便對話可以連續重播而沒有間隙。
chunks: to be added to the equation,

reviewData.pronunciation: advances 重音在第二音節 /ədˈvænsɪz/，computing 重音在第二音節 /kəmˈpjuː.tɪŋ/。
replayed 重音在第二音節 /ˌriːˈpleɪd/，continuously 重音在第二音節 /kənˈtɪn.ju.əs.li/。

8_25.en: This process is called pulse-code modulation, and today it remains the method used by computers, MP3 players, and compact discs to translate sounds into digital form.
8_25.zh: 這個過程被稱為脈衝編碼調變，直到今天，它仍然是電腦、MP3播放器和CD用來將聲音轉換為數位形式的方法。
chunks: to translate sounds into digital form.

reviewData.meaning: 它仍然是那個方法（remain = 依然是）
reviewData.synonym: it continues to be the method
reviewData.pronunciation: remains 重音在第二音節 /rɪˈmeɪnz/，the method 的 the 在母音前唸 /ðiː/。

reviewData.chunk: to translate sounds into digital form.
reviewData.meaning: 將聲音轉換成數位形式
reviewData.synonym: to convert sounds to digital data
reviewData.pronunciation: translate 重音在第二音節 /trænsˈleɪt/，digital 的 /dɪdʒ/ 清楚。
